description: Colour-emoji skin-tone sequences (add_international_text v1.7.0 on pdfnative 1.8): the COLRv1 module bundles 150 modifier sequences — 20 gestures and 10 generic people × the five Fitzpatrick tones — so a base emoji followed by U+1F3FB…U+1F3FF draws as ONE toned glyph instead of two. Flags and ZWJ sequences (1.7) keep working. Combine `emoji` with a text script. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.
